decision.summary: The Federal Reserve lowered interest rates by a quarter point to support the economy amid global risks and low inflation.

changes.quote: The Committee will continue to monitor the implications of incoming information for the economic outlook as it assesses the appropriate path of the target range for the federal funds rate.
changes.explanation: This new phrasing suggests the Fed is shifting away from active rate cuts and into a period of observation.

changes.quote: In light of the implications of global developments for the economic outlook as well as muted inflation pressures, the Committee decided to lower the target range for the federal funds rate to 1-1/2 to 1-3/4 percent.
changes.explanation: The Fed is cutting rates to provide insurance against weak growth in other countries and inflation that remains too low.

tone_quotes.quote: In light of the implications of global developments for the economic outlook as well as muted inflation pressures, the Committee decided to lower the target range for the federal funds rate to 1-1/2 to 1-3/4 percent.
The Committee will continue to monitor the implications of incoming information for the economic outlook as it assesses the appropriate path of the target range for the federal funds rate.

for_you.text: On a $5,000 card balance at about 15.13% APR, a 25 bp cut lowers monthly interest by about $1.04.

Mortgages track the 10-year Treasury, not the fed funds rate. The 10-year was 1.78% and moved -6 bp on the day; if that move passed through, the payment on a new $300,000 30-year loan at 3.69% would fall by about $10.15 a month.
High-yield savings rates usually follow the Fed partly; on $10,000 that means roughly $15.00 a year less in interest.
Unemployment was 3.5%, and employers added an average of 176k jobs a month over the prior 3 months.

for_country.text: Core PCE inflation, the Fed's preferred gauge, was 1.6%, against a 2% goal.
Real GDP grew at a 4.8% annualized pace in the latest reported quarter.
The 2-year Treasury yield moved -3 bp on the day, and the S&P 500 moved 0.33%.
The broad trade-weighted dollar moved 0.16% on the day.

card.whats_next: The Committee removed its previous pledge to act as appropriate to sustain the expansion. This change suggests that officials believe interest rates are now in a good place and will likely remain steady.
